change: Shard of the Ledger drops on every Haul clear at 15% (was 5% per Reserve chest)
after: 15% per Haul clear, any page, any route
rationale: Dead end: the max-value route pays a Reserve chest only on the Ore Vault (1 page in 6), so a sensible player gets ~0.007 Ledger shards per Haul run (~0.03 a dedicated weekend); even a Reserve-chasing route gets ~0.024. Tying it to the clear removes the route dependency and keeps the Haul's route choice about value, not shards.

change: Shard of the Keel 1% -> 4% per full Wreck clear
rationale: At 1% a dedicated player sees ~0.16 a weekend; 37% of players go 100 clears without one. 4% gives ~0.65 a dedicated weekend, so the Wreck's own shard usually arrives before Salvage has to buy it.

change: Shard of the Crown 15% -> 40% per Crownhold clear
rationale: Crownhold is gated by the Lantern (~1 run a dedicated weekend, ~0.3 a casual weekend), so at 15% the Crown shard is ~0.1 a dedicated weekend. 40% makes Crownhold the natural home of its shard for dedicated and hardcore players.

change: Shard of the Tide 3% -> 25% on the Sealed Reliquary, The Fall and both tainted runs
rationale: Steeping eats most Epic charts, so a dedicated player runs only ~0.9 Epic or tainted runs a weekend (~0.6 clears). At 3% the Tide shard is ~0.03 a weekend, the rarest shard of all.

Salvage is the pacing lever: it buys whichever shard is missing, so it sets both the median and the dry-streak tail. Natural drops alone cannot reach the target because the key waits on the rarest of four.

change: Salvage exchange for any Invitation shard 100 -> 35
rationale: With R5, one shard costs 7 full clears (about 4 hours of Wreck), and every uber clear's 40 Salvage refunds one shard. Note: a shard (35) is then cheaper than an Archive or Watch chart (40); the chart prices can stay, since they compete for the same Salvage.

No director target exists. At 8, a hardcore player at a 15% clear rate needs ~53 keys: ~100 weekends today, ~22 weekends even with R1-R6; casual and dedicated players never get there. At 4 it is a ~10-weekend hardcore chase (p90 ~17) and out of reach for most others. Director's call: leave at 8 if the Remainder is meant as a near-unreachable trophy.
